features.label: Precise surgical protocol adherence
features.text: Safeguard your vulnerable healing tissues by utilizing the specialized flexion and extension stops, which allow you and your orthopedic specialist to dictate the exact biomechanical bending angles of your knee joint to prevent catastrophic hyperextension during active rehabilitation

features.label: Anatomical hinge calibration
features.text: Eliminating the frustrating gap between your skin and the rigid carbon fiber frame is critical for load distribution, and the included varying thicknesses of Condyle Pads allow you to perfectly shim the medial and lateral hinges flush against your specific joint width for uncompromising stability

features.label: Targeted posterior cruciate support
features.text: Traditional bracing often fails to address specific posterior tibial translation, but the dedicated PCL Strap Kit is engineered to deliver highly specialized, counter-acting pressure to the back of the calf, ensuring your PCL graft remains completely isolated and protected during the vulnerable early stages of recovery

features.label: Critical structural maintenance
features.text: The physical safety of a functional knee brace relies entirely on its mechanical fastening points, meaning that replacing worn or stripped D-rings, guard cords, and high-tensile screws with authentic OEM hardware will instantly restore the heavy-duty integrity needed for extreme sports and daily wear

features.label: Perfect fit guarantee
features.text: Free virtual fitting and adjustment session with our US-based brace specialists to ensure your new components are installed correctly for personalized support

measurement: Choose the specific replacement component you need from the available options (Tibial Wedge Pad, Guard Cord, Guard Screws, Condyle Pad Set, Extension Stop Set, Flexion Stop Set, Hinge Sticker Set, D-Ring Set, or PCL Strap Kit). Note: Brace is not included. Visit our Perfect Fit Promise page for more details.
